description: i18n audit (plan.md decision 7, checklist I1-I9): every user-visible server string goes through Paraglide when the error is created (ServiceError/IdentityError/AuthModuleError, lazy Zod messages, guard and page errors, flash, form action errors), API-only and operator strings stay English; auth module config labels built per call; framework 404/500 messages localized in handleError; locale-aware formatDateTime/formatNumber (fixes the tournament page crash with a start time); Paraglide strategy gains preferredLanguage so a second locale needs only a messages file and a settings entry (README 'Translations'); messages.spec.ts guard. Runs after FEAT-001..003 so it covers their code; keep the English text identical so existing tests keep passing.
steps: I1: move every message literal into messages/en.json (verbatim English, params as {name}) in src/lib/server/services/{apiKeys,chat,identities,matches,organizations,participants,requirements,stages,tournaments,users}.ts, src/lib/server/auth/username.ts and src/lib/tournaments.ts. ServiceError/IdentityError: `throw new ServiceError(m.registration_error_closed())`. Zod: `.min(1, { error: () => m.validation_name_required() })`, `z.string({ error: () => m.chat_error_empty() })`, `z.uuid({ error: () => m.match_error_not_found() })`, `.regex(re, { error: () => … })`, `.refine(fn, { error: () => … })`. Replace module constants (SLUG_TAKEN) with calls at the throw. setStatus uses `statusLabel` from '#lib/labels.ts' for both statuses. Key prefixes: validation_* (shared form rules: name, description, slug, username, display name, bio), <area>_error_* (service rules), error_* (page errors).

I2: localize guard and page errors and flash: src/lib/server/auth/{guards,org,tournament}.ts; src/routes/auth/[module]/login/+server.ts, auth/[module]/callback/+server.ts (404 and the expired-sign-in flash), o/[org]/+page.server.ts, o/[org]/admin/members/+page.server.ts ('Choose a valid role.'), settings/identities/+page.server.ts, t/[org]/[tournament]/admin/+page.server.ts ('Unknown step.'), t/[org]/[tournament]/matches/[id]/+page.server.ts, matches/[id]/events/+server.ts, u/[username]/+page.server.ts. Leave src/lib/server/api/**, src/lib/server/auth/apiKey.ts, src/routes/api/**, src/lib/server/modules/config.ts and src/lib/server/themes.ts English.

I3: auth modules. src/lib/server/modules/types.ts: `configFields?(): ConfigField[]` with a doc line that it's built per request so labels follow the locale. src/lib/server/modules/auth/tetrio.ts: refine messages lazy, eligibility reasons, formatRank's 'Unranked', rankOptions ('Any') and tetrioConfigFields become functions (`tetrioConfigFields(): ConfigField[]`, module `configFields: tetrioConfigFields`), AuthModuleError messages, bracketFields TR via formatNumber. src/lib/server/modules/oauth2.ts, auth/dev.ts, auth/discord.ts AuthModuleError messages (keep dev's 'Username must be 3–32 characters…' text exactly; e2e asserts it). Update readers: services/requirements.ts readModuleConfig (`module.configFields?.() ?? []`), routes t/[org]/[tournament]/admin/requirements/+page.server.ts load (`fields: module.configFields?.() ?? []`), and any test fakes (modules.spec.ts, requirements.spec.ts). Module names stay as defined.

I4: src/hooks.server.ts: export `handleError` (type `HandleServerError`, imported like `Handle` — check the SvelteKit 3 export path in node_modules/@sveltejs/kit types) returning `{ message: status === 404 ? m.error_not_found() : m.error_title() }`, logging unexpected (non-404) errors with console.error as SvelteKit's default does.

I5: src/lib/format.ts: `formatDateTime(date)` (`date.toLocaleString(getLocale(), { dateStyle: 'medium', timeStyle: 'short' })`) and `formatNumber(value)` (`value.toLocaleString(getLocale())`) with doc comments. Use formatDateTime in src/routes/t/[org]/[tournament]/+layout.svelte (toLocaleDateString with timeStyle throws in V8 today, so pages with a start time answer 500). Check src/routes/u/[username]/+page.svelte uses formatDate (FEAT-002). New src/lib/format.spec.ts: formatDateTime(new Date('2030-05-01T18:00:00Z')) contains '2030' and ':00' and doesn't throw; formatNumber(1234567) is '1,234,567'; formatDate default; formatScore/formatRecord.
I6: e2e/auth.e2e.ts: `await expect(page.locator('html')).toHaveAttribute('lang', 'en');` (app.html + hooks already wire it).

I7: vite.config.ts paraglideVitePlugin: `strategy: ['cookie', 'preferredLanguage', 'baseLocale']` with a comment (browsers get their Accept-Language locale once one exists; the cookie overrides). package.json `check` and `prepare`: append `--strategy cookie preferredLanguage baseLocale` to `paraglide-js compile`. README.md '## Translations': UI strings are in messages/en.json (Paraglide); to add a language copy it to messages/<locale>.json, translate it, and add the locale to `locales` in project.inlang/settings.json; browsers that prefer it get it, dates and numbers follow via src/lib/format.ts, `<html lang>` follows; the REST API answers in English.

I8: new src/lib/messages.spec.ts (pure; node:fs readFileSync/readdirSync with { recursive: true } from process.cwd()): (a) every key in messages/en.json except $schema is referenced as `m.<key>` (regex `\bm\.(\w+)`) in some .ts/.svelte file under src excluding src/lib/paraglide, listing the unused keys in the failure; (b) every .svelte file under src, after removing <script>…</script>, <style>…</style>, <!-- … -->, brace-matched {…} blocks, HTML entities and tags, has no run of two or more letters left, and has no literal `aria-label="…"`, `title="…"`, `placeholder="…"` or `alt="…"` value containing a letter; failures name the file and text. Fix what it reports (remove unused keys or use them; move text into en.json); a tiny explicit allowlist only for real non-text cases.

I9: re-run the literal search from planning (PowerShell Select-String for quoted capitalised sentences over src/lib/server/{services,auth,modules}, src/lib/tournaments.ts and src/routes excluding routes/api) and confirm only API-only and operator strings remain; tick I1-I9 in plan.md's checklist with the files touched.
Record in `findings` the key prefixes used and the exceptions (API-only, operator, module names) for the PLAN.md notes.
acceptance_criteria: No hardcoded user-visible string remains in .svelte files, form action errors, flash messages, guard/page errors or service errors that reach the UI; API-only and operator strings are the documented exceptions.
`corepack pnpm test:unit --run` passes, including messages.spec.ts, format.spec.ts and every existing test that asserts English messages.
A tournament with a start time renders its public page (formatDateTime).
`corepack pnpm check` 0 errors / 0 warnings; the full e2e suite passes, including the html lang assertion.
README documents adding a locale with only a messages file and a settings entry.
findings: Done, uncommitted. Verified: corepack pnpm format; check 0 errors / 0 warnings; lint clean; test:unit --run 36 files / 404 tests pass (new: src/lib/format.spec.ts 5 tests, src/lib/messages.spec.ts 3 tests); full test:e2e 15 passed (auth.e2e.ts now asserts ). KEYS (messages/en.json, appended at the end, English verbatim): validation_* (name_required, name_max {max}, description_max {max}, slug_min {min}, slug_max {max}, slug_format, slug_taken, username_min/max/format, display_name_required/_max, bio_max); _error_* (user_error_unknown {username}, members_error_already/last_owner/role, identity_error_taken/other/last/no_refresh/not_linked {module}, tournament_error_locked/limit_min/limit_max/delete_draft/status {from,to}/signed_up, theme_error_unavailable, structure_error_final_groups, requirements_error_config '{module}: {error}', registration_error_closed/already/full/link/unavailable/leave, check_in_error_closed/not_registered, participants_error_started/already/not_found/seeds, stage_error_too_few/groups/advance_group/advance_total/not_open/no_next/unfinished, match_error_not_found/scores_missing/scores_invalid/stage_not_running/draw/not_ready/not_running/cannot_report/not_player/help_closed/help_not_player, chat_error_empty/too_long/not_allowed, lifecycle_error_unknown); error_* page errors (error_not_found 'Page not found', error_untrusted, error_org_not_found, error_not_member, error_owner_only, error_tournament_not_found, error_match_not_found); auth_error_* (unknown_module, expired, cancelled, provider, no_code, verify, no_token, dev_username), discord_error_account; tetrio_* (error_down/gone/no_account/rank_order/tr_order, unranked, any, tr '{tr} TR', need_rank, min_rank, max_rank, min_tr, max_tr, field_*); theme_default_name, theme_default_description, theme_tetrio_description. The disputed report error reuses room_disputed. Removed unused keys nav_profile and theme_module (messages.spec found them). APIS: AuthModule.configFields is now a method `configFields?(): ConfigField[]` (readers: requirements.ts readModuleConfig, admin/requirements load); tetrio exports `tetrioConfigFields()` (function); format.ts adds formatDateTime(date) and formatNumber(value); hooks.server.ts exports handleError (SvelteKit 3 HandleServerError gets { kind, error }: 'app' keeps its message, 'unknown' is console.error'ed and answers m.error_title(), framework/validation answer m.error_not_found() for 404 else m.error_title()); setStatus's message uses statusLabel (e.g. 'A tournament can't go from Draft to Check-in.'). Themes: default/tetrio `name`/`description` are getters calling m.* (TETR.IO name stays); ParticipantLabel compares the rank with m.tetrio_unranked() and its TR title uses m.tetrio_tr. Paraglide strategy is ['cookie','preferredLanguage','baseLocale'] in vite.config.ts and `--strategy cookie preferredLanguage baseLocale` in package.json check/prepare (globalVariable dropped). README '## Translations' added after '## REST API'. messages.spec.ts: (a) every en.json key is referenced as m. in src .ts/.svelte (paraglide output and *.spec.ts excluded); (b) .svelte markup without script/style/comments/{…}/…/tags/entities has no 2+ letter run, and no literal aria-label/title/placeholder/alt with letters; no allowlist needed ( content counts as code: the API docs header and the tm_ key format). EXCEPTIONS for PLAN.md notes: API-only stays English (src/lib/server/api/**, auth/apiKey.ts, routes/api/**, services/requirements.ts parseRequirements); operator errors stay English (modules/config.ts, server/themes.ts, the logged-only Steam fetch errors in services/steam.ts); auth module names (Discord, TETR.IO, Development login) and the TETR.IO theme name stay as defined; Zod's built-in messages for type checks (e.g. z.number().int(), structure array min/max) are Zod's own. API clients get service messages in the base locale (no cookie, no browser language). The start-time crash fix is covered by format.spec.ts (formatDateTime doesn't throw); no e2e sets a start time.
